app_fee.value: International degree-seeking applicants pay a $100 application fee; domestic applicants pay $65.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are automatic only for listed US groups; other applicants submit a request, and only certain programs sponsor the fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Note, only certain programs offer sponsorship for application fees.

also.quote: Other applicants may submit a fee waiver request.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School leaves GRE or GMAT to each program; the program record gives its own rule.
gre_general.quote: Some programs require tests such as the GRE or the GMAT

toefl_min.value: Minimum for admission on the new TOEFL iBT scale is 3.5 with no part below 3.5; applicants reaching 4.5 with no part below 4.5 are fully proficient and skip Applied English Center testing.
toefl_min.quote: Total score of 3.5 with no part score below 3.5

also.quote: Total score of 4.5 with no part score below 4.5

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum for admission is 5.5 overall with no part below 5.0; 6.5 overall with no part below 6.0 gives full proficiency.
ielts_min.quote: Total score of 5.5 with no part score below 5.0

also.quote: Total score of 6.5 with no part score below 6.0

english_waiver.value: An English-medium bachelor's from a foreign university can waive the English test, but the transcript must confirm English as the medium and a registrar letter may be required; India is not named.
english_waiver.quote: A Medium-of-Instruction letter may be required if English instruction cannot be confirmed.

also.quote: A baccalaureate degree (or higher) from a foreign university that conducts all instruction in English

notes: Fields from gradapply.ku.edu/apply and gradapply.ku.edu/english-requirements. The doctoral programs list is degrees.ku.edu/graduate/doctoral/. Department rules are in the program records.
